title: Cupboard
summary: Cupboard provides code, frameworks, and utilities for minecraft mods
description:
Cupboard provides code, different frameworks and utilities for minecraft mods
Features:

  • Json config framework
  • Full stacktrace crashes
  • Error logging for commands
  • Debug logging for sync chunk loading
  • Prevents common entity loading crashes with invalid rotations

Incompatible with Dimensional threading

If you enjoy this mod consider supporting the development, any support is greatly appreciated.

The development is an unpaid free-time activity, so any support helps being able to spend more time on it.
You can support me on Patreon or just spreading the word around.
